candidate_dependency.component: LLVM libc++ review and production integration

control_statement: LLVM review, translation, benchmarking, and integration were material to production adoption of the generated routines, but the source record distinguishes them from the AlphaDev reinforcement-learning system that generated the candidate routines. Production integration must not be recoded as necessary to candidate generation.
falsification_use: Tests dependency inflation by requiring the analysis to separate a technology needed to generate a result from infrastructure used later to translate, review, benchmark, integrate, or distribute it.
evidence_boundary: The source record states that the target routines were generated through AlphaDev reinforcement-learning search.
The source record separately records human translation, LLVM review, hardware benchmarking, and integration.
No claim is made that LLVM was unnecessary to later production use.
limitations: The exact internal candidate-generation date remains unresolved.
This control addresses dependency classification, not novelty or performance validity.
Other software/hardware dependencies may still be necessary to reproduce or deploy the result.
